**backstory_b.spc_wanderer_khuzait_10** — At any rate, that wasn't the life for me. So I made up my mind to run off to the grasses, find one of those tribes that doesn't answer to the khan and takes in fugitives. The Karakhuzaits, they call them. Problem is I first needed a horse.

**backstory_c.spc_wanderer_khuzait_10** — Anyway I hung around the marketplace in Chaikand, looking for a likely candidate. Eventually I found an animal whose owner hadn't tied up too well as he went off to get drunk. So I took it and ran. And you know what? The cursed beast threw me, not one league out of town, and ran back to his sodden master.

**response_1.spc_wanderer_khuzait_10** — Oh well. I guess you've got spirit.

**response_2.spc_wanderer_khuzait_10** — Hah! May all thieves fail as you did.

**backstory_d.spc_wanderer_khuzait_10** — Anyway, I guess I need a new plan to make my way in the world. But I'm not going to be a peddlar like my dad, I'll tell you that much. Maybe I'll fight and ride, or maybe I'll be a rich merchant running caravans, but one way or the other, I intend to find my place among the hawks of the world rather than the pigeons.

**generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_khuzait_10** — I was the son of a village peddler but that's not the kind of life I want to live. I want to learn to fight and ride. There are a lot of us lads like that in the Khuzait lands, I think you'll find, even if the great horse lords think we're fit only to stitch sandals or push a plough.

**str_surrender_demand_repeated.default** — But enough talking. Yield or fight![ib:warrior][if:convo_angry]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.default** — I've got you cornered. Yield, or we shall attack.[ib:warrior][if:convo_aggressive]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.default_2** — A pity you and I have to fight. Do you want to give up?[ib:warrior][if:convo_stern]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.default_3** — It grieves me to fight you, but I must. Unless of course you wish to surrender.[ib:warrior][if:convo_stern]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.default_4** — I don't expect you to surrender, but I'll give you the chance to do so.[ib:warrior][if:convo_stern]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.default_5** — It's Fortune's idea of a good joke to make old friends fight. Shall we dance to her tune, or do you want to give up?[ib:warrior][if:convo_nonchalant]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.curt** — I've got you cornered. Yield or die.[ib:warrior][if:convo_aggressive]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.martial_imperial** — The odds are not in your favor today. You may fight us, but there is also no shame if you yield now.[ib:warrior][if:convo_thinking]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.martial_barbarian** — You're outnumbered. Give up. Or don't. Death in battle is a fine thing.[ib:warrior][if:convo_bored]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.ironic** — I can offer you a glorious death in battle, or the hospitality of my dungeons.[ib:warrior][if:convo_mocking_teasing]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.pitiless** — You cannot defeat me, and I'll teach you a painful lesson if you try. Yield![ib:warrior][if:convo_angry]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.sadistic** — You've got no chance. Surrender or I'll gut you like a fish.[ib:warrior][if:convo_angry]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.goodnatured** — We have the advantage of you. Yield, and you will be well-treated.[ib:warrior][if:convo_stern]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.upstanding** — You may fight us, but many of your men will be killed, and you will probably lose. Yield, and spare us both the unnecessary bloodshed.[ib:warrior][if:convo_stern]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.cunning** — You are outmatched today. Give up  if not for your own sake, then think of your men![ib:warrior][if:convo_thinking]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.cruel** — You can surrender, but I hope you don't. I'd enjoy sticking a blade into you until you squeal.[ib:warrior][if:convo_mocking_revenge]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.cunning_2** — Oh, I suppose I'm obligated to give you a chance to grovel for your life. Will you surrender, then?[ib:warrior][if:convo_mocking_revenge]

**str_surrender_demand_hero.cunning_3** — Oh, I suppose I'm obligated to give you a chance to surrender, but I hope you don't. I'm rather looking forward to seeing how well attached your head is to your neck.[ib:warrior][if:convo_mocking_aristocratic]

**str_surrender_offer.calculating_honor** — Enough! I choose to live to fight another day. I trust you will respect the custom of war, and allow me to pay a fair ransom.[if:convo_thinking]

**str_prisoner_released.sadistic** — Am I? So refined is your cruelty, that you would rather see me free and humiliated, than in chains. Enjoy your triumph![if:convo_contemptuous]

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_calculating1** — You raided my village at {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Well, I'm here now to pay back what I owe you.

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_valor_2** — You raided my village at {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. You'll die for that!

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_honor0** — I heard you raided {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. That's my property, you cretin. You think you can make me look weak? You'll die for this.

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_default** — You raided my village at {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Well, I'm here now to pay back what I owe you.

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_martial** — I hear you have a habit of attacking helpless villagers, like my tenants at {VILLAGE_NAME}. I think you'll find my men a tougher morsel to chew.

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_goodnatured** — I hear you're the one who raided my village of {SETTLEMENT_NAME} and lifted the crops and livestock. I suspect your men must have been hungry, but so are my tenants. Shall we battle for what's left?

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_sadistic** — For every house of mine that you burned when your raided {SETTLEMENT_NAME}, I'm going to carve another piece from your body.

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_sadistic2** — You took my property when you raided {VILLAGE_NAME}, so I'm going to take your head and mount it to the first building we rebuild.

**str_comment_you_raided_my_village.enemy_roguish** — You attacked my village at {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Oh, I won't pretend that my men would also have had a bit of fun if it was me paying a visit to your village. But as my tenants' protector, I have a certain obligation to avenge them a bit. Please don't take this personally.

**str_comment_intro.default1** — I shall remember your name.

**str_comment_intro.default2** — It's good to meet you.

**str_comment_intro.default3** — I shall remember your name.

**str_comment_intro.default4** — I'll remember your name.

**str_comment_intro.default5** — I'll mark your name.

**str_comment_intro.default6** — I'll remember your name.

**str_comment_intro.under_command** — You have my allegiance.

**str_comment_intro.under_command_ironic** — It goes without saying that you have my allegiance.

**str_comment_intro.under_command_gangleader** — My lads and I... Whatever you've heard, we respect authority. We hope we can be of service.

**str_comment_intro.under_command_gangleader_cruel** — You have my allegiance. If I hear a word spoken against you, I'll cut that person's tongue out.

**str_comment_intro.famous_earnest** — I have heard your name. People speak of your deeds. It is good to finally meet you.

**str_comment_intro.famous_curt** — I've heard your name.

**str_comment_intro.famous_ironic** — So... You've made quite a name for yourself...

**str_comment_intro.famous_softspoken** — I know your name. It's good to meet.

**str_comment_intro.famous_honor** — I am sure someone with your reputation knows that nothing in this world is as valuable as the weight of your word. Speak truthfully with me, and I shall do the same with you.

**str_comment_intro.famous_martial** — I know your name. They say you are a {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} of valor. If fate ever decrees that we cross swords, it would be an honor.

**str_comment_intro.famous_badtempered** — I've heard about you. So now we meet. I'm not one for talk, so if you have anything to tell me, say it.

**str_comment_intro.famous_badtempered_emp** — I have heard of you. I am not in a mood for banter, so let us dispense with the courtesies.

**str_comment_intro.famous_badtempered_low** — Yeah... I know your name. Right. I'm not one for chat, so let's skip the soup and go straight to the meat.

**str_comment_intro.famous_pitiless** — I have heard of you. Your name strikes fear in men's hearts. That is the best kind of reputation to have. Perhaps we may have interests in common.

**str_comment_intro.famous_sadistic** — I know your name -- and from what they say about you, I'd say that many a grieving widow knows too. But that is no concern of mine.

**str_comment_intro.famous_cunning** — I've heard of you. At last we meet. You sound like a good {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} to know. Let us speak together, from time to time.

**str_comment_intro.famous_dodgy_merchant** — I've heard of you. They say good things about you. Let's talk, from time to time. A friendship with someone like me can be quite profitable for someone like you.

**str_comment_intro.famous_cunning_merchant** — I've heard of you. At last we meet. You sound like a good {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} to know. Let us speak together, from time to time. We may be able to find arrangements that benefit us both.

**str_comment_intro.preacher_default** — The Heavens will shall be done. But those who smooth the path shall be rewarded.

**str_comment_intro.preacher_justice** — Uphold the rights of the poor and the meek, of the widow and the orphan, and the Heavens will take note.

**str_comment_intro.preacher_truth** — The Heavens have blessed us with their commandments, which we must uphold and ensure others uphold.

**str_comment_intro.preacher_mystic** — Seek not the things of this world, but thirst after the divine truth.

**str_comment_intro.famous_friendly** — I've heard of you! I have long wanted to make your acquaintance.

**str_comment_intro.famous_friendly_2** — I've heard of you! A pity we should meet like this.

**str_comment_intro.famous_upstanding** — I know your name. Men praise your valor. But remember that honor and compassion are also worth cultivating.

**str_comment_intro.outlaw** — Yeah... I know your name. I've got nothing against you, friend. Stay out of my business, and I'll stay out of yours.

**str_comment_intro.known_default** — Yes... I believe I may have heard your name.

**str_comment_intro.known_hostile** — I think I have heard your name. I believe you caused some trouble for us.

**str_comment_intro.known_hostile_earnest** — I know your name. I can only hope that what I have heard is not true.

**str_comment_intro.known_attracted** — Ah yes. I believe I have heard your name. It is indeed a pleasure to meet face to face.

**str_comment_intro.common_cunning** — I have not heard of you, but you have the look of a {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} who might make something of {?PLAYER.GENDER}herself{?}himself{\?}, some day.

**str_comment_intro.common_goodnatured** — I can't say that I've heard the name, but it's good to make your acquaintance.

**str_comment_intro.impolite_default** — Is this important? I'm rather busy right now.

**str_comment_intro.common_patrician** — I shall have my scribes make a note of your name.

**str_comment_intro.uncharitable** — Never heard of you.

**str_comment_intro.common_taciturn_cruel** — One thing you should know: If you cross me, you'll regret it.

**str_comment_intro.common_honor_2** — It is good to meet you. Remember, there is no currency in this world more valuable than the weight of your word, so speak truthfully with me, and I shall do the same with you.

**str_comment_intro.common_honor_low** — Good to meet you. Look, one thing I value is that people keep their word, so deal straight with me and I'll deal straight with you.

**str_comment_intro.common_nasty** — I've never heard of you. No doubt another vulture come to this land to grow fat on the leftovers of war.

**str_comment_intro.common_valor** — It is good to meet you. I am always looking for warriors who value courage, glory and a good name.

**str_comment_intro.tribal** — I don't know your name. But no matter. Some say there is greater honor to found a great lineage than to be born with one.

**str_comment_intro.common_psych** — The one thing about me you should know, is that I make a very good friend and you absolutely do not want me as an enemy.

**str_comment_intro.common_cautious** — I shall mark down your name. Now, do not take it amiss if I do not immediately extend my hand in friendship, for the world is a treacherous place, and I have learned to be wary.

**str_comment_intro.common_cautious_2** — I shall mark down your name. But you shall have to earn my trust, stranger, for the world is a treacherous place, and these are treacherous times.

**str_comment_intro.generosity_sturgian** — It is good to know your name. If I see you at a feast, I'll know how to greet you, and if I see you in a shield wall, I'll know whom I slay.

**str_comment_intro.cruel_sturgian** — Know that if you ever cross me, you'll wind up as food for the ravens.

**str_comment_intro.cruel_khuzait** — Know that if you ever cross me, you'll wind up as food for the jackals.

**str_comment_intro.attacking2** — It is good to know who one fights.

**str_comment_intro.attacking3** — I'm not sure what to make of you, except you're either very brave or very rash, or both.

**str_comment_intro.attacking4** — Never heard of you. Doubt you'll give me much trouble.

**str_comment_intro.common_soldier** — I'm always looking for good fighters. If you ask about me, I suspect you'll be told that I take good care of my men.

**str_comment_intro.cautious** — I'm not one of those who loves war for its own sake. But I still need reliable warriors who are true to their word. I will keep faith with all those who keep faith with me.

**str_comment_intro.common_stoic** — I will always listen to a {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} of integrity. On the other hand, if you lack that, please do not plague me with your company.

**str_comment_intro.common_honor** — I'll deal with those who keep their oaths. If you're one of those who don't value their word, don't waste my time.

**str_comment_intro.common_blowhard** — If you ever want a chance for glory, you might want to consider fighting for me. One day you can tell your grandchildren that you served under my command.

**str_comment_intro.common_goodnatured_2** — It is good to meet you. Always remember that while courage is commendable, compassion is the greatest of virtues.

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_liege** — I have heard much about you. Some men may fear a woman who is versed in the art of war, but I for one will not turn away hands that can grip a sword, should their owner be brave and loyal.

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_martial** — I have heard much about you. They say that you are the equal of even the bravest of men in your prowess at arms. Perhaps one day I shall try my valor against yours, either in a tournament or on the battlefield!

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_badtempered** — I've heard of talk of you -- the woman who knows how to fight like a man.

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_pitiless** — I know your name. It strikes fear in men's hearts. That is good. Perhaps we should speak together, some time.

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_cunning** — Ah, yes. At last we meet. You sound like a good woman to know. Let us speak together, from time to time.

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_sadistic** — I know your name -- and from what I hear, I'll warrant that many a grieving widow knows too. But that is no concern of mine.

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_goodnatured** — I've heard of you! It's very good to finally make your acquaintance.

**str_comment_intro.female_famous_upstanding** — I know your name. They say you are a most valiant warrior. I can only hope that your honour and mercy matches your valor.

**str_comment_intro.female_noble_martial** — I do not recognize your banner, but clearly you are a lady of rank. Please consider me your most humble servant.

**str_comment_intro.female_admiring_goodnatured** — My lady, if you are skilled as arms as you are fair in countenance, then your enemies should indeed fear you!

**str_comment_intro.attracted_famous** — I've heard of you. They spoke of you as an impressive warrior. They had not mentioned that you were so, em, charming.

**str_comment_intro.attracted_famous_ironic** — Ah, yes. From what they said of you, I had imagined someone whose blade was still dripping with the blood of her enemies, not someone with your grace and charms.

**str_comment_intro.attracted_not_famous_female** — It's an honor to meet you, my lady.

**str_comment_intro.female_admiring_highregister** — It's an honor to meet you, good sir.

**str_comment_intro.female_admiring_gangleader_lowregister** — You're a handsome devil, aren't you? Bet you're a load of trouble, though.

**str_comment_intro.female_admiring_gangleader_tribalregister** — So, my young lion. You have the look of someone who may go far, if they don't wind up dead.

**str_comment_intro.female_admiring_lowregister** — Pleasure to meet you.

**str_comment_intro.female_admiring_tribalregister** — I am glad to meet you.

**str_comment_you_defeated_me_in_single_combat.default** — I am still recovering from the bruises you gave me.

**str_comment_i_defeated_you_in_single_combat.default** — Remember how I beat you, one-on-one? Are you back for more?

**str_comment_i_defeated_you_in_single_combat.default_2** — I won our last duel, but you fought well. I wouldn't blame you if you wished for a rematch.

**str_comment_i_defeated_you_in_single_combat.default_3** — Remember our duel? It was a good fight. But with the advantage I have now, I'm afraid I can't afford to be so sporting.

**str_comment_we_have_rebelled.default** — We can take no more! We have raised the standard of rebellion, and will fight the people's enemies until our just demands are met.

**str_comment_we_have_rebelled.cruel** — We're not putting up with it any more. We will spill the blood of the oppressors and anyone who stands in the way of our just wrath.

**str_parley_comment.default** — I will honor the terms of the parley if you do likewise.

**str_parley_comment.honorable** — You asked for a parley. I will trust you will honor the customs of war and attempt no tricks.

**str_parley_comment.distrustful_d** — You asked for a parley. If you're tempted to try any tricks, do know I have some archers standing by to keep you honest.

**str_courtship_travel_task.default** — They say you have travelled quite widely. Tell me a bit about your journeys...

**str_courtship_travel_task.curt** — Heard you get around quite a bit... So... Tell me a bit about your travels, then.

**str_courtship_travel_task.moralist** — They say you've travelled widely. Such terrible times we live in, so much hardship. What do you think of what you've seen?

**str_courtship_travel_task.noncombatant** — You are, I hear, a man of the world, as they say. Tell me a bit about your journeys.

**str_courtship_travel_task.thrillseeker** — So... I've heard you've travelled around a fair bit. No doubt you've seen a lot of strange and awful things. Maybe you've done a few strange and awful things. Go on, tell me a bit about your journeys. I promise not to be shocked.

**str_courtship_aspirations_task.default** — Some people say you will go far... Suppose you were to rise to a position of power. What would you do?

**str_courtship_aspirations_task.amoral_ironic** — Now don't take this the wrong way, but some would say that you're aiming a bit beyond your station. But lets say your rise in the world. What would you do?

**str_courtship_aspirations_task.amoral** — I shall put this bluntly. You are not from a good family. Some would say you are setting your sights too high. But suppose you were to rise in the world. What would you do?

**str_courtship_aspirations_task.honor** — You may be of humble birth, but you seem like the type who will rise in the world. Suppose you were to come to a position of power and responsibility. How would you use it?

**str_comment_quest_taken.gangleader** — Thanks again for taking on that little matter for me. Best of luck.

**str_comment_quest_taken.lowreg** — Thanks again for agreeing to handle that matter for me.

**str_comment_quest_taken.ironic** — Thank you again for agreeing to handle that problem of mine. Best of luck with it.

**str_comment_quest_taken.not_ironic** — Again, I'm glad to have your assistance.

**str_comment_quest_betrayed.default** — So... Not long ago, you betrayed my trust. Do we really have anything to discuss?

**str_comment_quest_betrayed.ironic** — Would you like me to give you another task, so that you can betray me again?

**str_comment_quest_betrayed.lowregister** — So... You really did me over. Not sure we have much to talk about now, after that.

**str_comment_quest_succeeded.default** — Thank you again for all your help.

**str_comment_quest_succeeded.curt** — You came through on that task I gave you. I thank you.

**str_comment_quest_succeeded.honest** — I thank you for what you did for me. You kept your word. Not everyone is so dependable these days.

**str_comment_quest_succeeded.amoral_ironic** — That task you took on for me. Very nicely done.

**str_comment_quest_succeeded.amoral_curt** — That job you did for me... Nice work.

**str_comment_quest_failed.default** — I know that the task I gave you was not easy... Well, let's not speak of that anymore.

**str_comment_quest_failed.honest** — So, about that task I gave you... Well, I can only hope that you gave it your best try, and you'd said you would.

**str_comment_quest_failed.calculating** — So, you weren't able to complete that task... Well, sometimes these things are out of our hands... and sometimes not. But let us not dwell on this.

**str_comment_quest_failed.impolite** — That job I gave you... I'd say you let me down.

**str_comment_quest_failed.lowreg** — So that problem I asked you to take care of... Didn't go so well, I hear.

**str_comment_quest_invalid.default** — I guess that task I gave you didn't work out.

**str_comment_quest_counteroffer_accepted.default** — I'm glad that we could come to an understanding on that recent matter.

**str_comment_quest_counteroffer_accepted.lowregister** — I'm glad that you and I could reach an agreement, earlier.

**str_barter_agreed.default** — Very well. I accept.

**str_barter_agreed.softspoken** — Very well. I accept.

**str_barter_agreed.curt** — Eh. Good enough.

**str_barter_agreed.ironic** — Your proposal is most acceptable.

**str_barter_agreed.earnest** — This is good. I'm glad that we could make this work.

**str_barter_refused.default** — I guess we don't have a deal.

**str_barter_refused.softspoken** — I guess we don't have a deal.

**str_barter_refused.curt** — No. That doesn't work.

**str_barter_refused.earnest** — So it looks like we don't have a deal But come up with a better proposal later, and I will listen.

**str_barter_refused.ironic** — Alas, I guess we simply don't see eye-to-eye on this.

**str_defect_barter_agreed.default** — It is a momentous step that I am about to take, and this makes it easier.

**str_defect_barter_agreed.softspoken** — It is a momentous step that I am about to take, and this makes it easier.

**str_defect_barter_agreed.earnest** — Very well. I am ready to do this.

**str_defect_barter_agreed.ironic** — Right. So that wraps up our little arrangement then.

**str_defect_barter_agreed.curt** — Very well. It is settled, then.

**str_defect_barter_refused.default** — No. That's not enough, for what you're asking me to do.

**str_defect_barter_refused.softspoken** — No. That's not enough, for what you're asking me to do.

**str_defect_barter_refused.earnest** — No -- I need more than that to be sure that I am not leading my followers to their deaths.

**str_defect_barter_refused.ironic** — Ah, look, I'd be happy to shed my blood for your cause. But I have to look out for my kin, and for those who look to me for protection. I need more from you.

**str_defect_barter_refused.curt** — No... Unless you can give me more, I can't do it.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_company_of_the_boar.default** — If you're ever looking for stout warriors, friend, you should think about hiring the Company of the Boar. The stoutest lads in Vlandia flock to our banner. Because if you don't hire us, your enemy might.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_legion_of_the_betrayed.default** — If you ever find yourself in a position to hire warriors, you should consider the Legion of the Betrayed. We know what it means to honor your word and contract, as we have seen the price of breaking faith.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_skolderbroda.default** — You may know of the Skolderbroda. On the battlefield, we are second to none. We expect to be paid according to our worth, and that is not cheap, but if we take your coin, you will have our oath to honor the terms of the contract, to our death if necessary.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_ghilman.default** — Perhaps one day we shall see each other on a battlefield. You shall know the Ghilman by the splendor of our steeds and the shimmer of our steel. If we are on your side, you may rejoice. If we are your enemy, you may save yourself a great deal of trouble by running away before the fighting starts.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_brotherhood_of_woods.default** — The common folk of these lands need someone looking after them. That's where our Brotherhood comes in. You'll hear us called bandits or robbers. Don't believe a word of it.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_hidden_hand.default** — When you walk these roads, my friend, know that nothing escapes the notice of the Hidden Hand. Lords and emperors come and go, but we remain.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_lakepike.default** — They call us the Lake Rats, but we prefer to be known as the free people of the marshes. No prince or boyar can make us bow our heads and scrape our knees. Know that, and we can probably get along fine.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_wolfskins.default** — Perhaps you've heard of the Wolfskins, traveller. We are beasts. Know that so long as we eat no cooked meat, wear no woven cloth, and sleep under no roof, we cannot be touched by the laws of men. So tread carefully with us.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_eleftheroi.default** — You may have heard of us - the Eleftheroi. Our fathers were thieves and runaways and troublemakers - we won't deny it. We came here because they didn't want us anywhere else. But I'll tell you this - if the empire survives, it'll be thanks to men like us, doing the hard bloody work out here in the wild fields, not those who sleep comfortably in their beds.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_forest_people.default** — We welcome strangers into our lands. The woods are wide, and there is game to be hunted and food to be gathered, enough for all. But there are some who come here to steal from us, to enslave us, or to tax us. Every spring, the bodies of those thieves are discovered in the thaw.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_jawwal.default** — Perhaps you have not heard of the Jawwal. Well, when you cross the desert, far from oasis and spring, in a land that others scorn, with thorns fit only for goats and camels, then you are in our domain.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_karakhergit.default** — Maybe you have not heard of the Karakhergit. We do venture much into the sewn lands, the corrupt lands. We bow to no Khan. We sew no grain. We keep to the old ways, out amid the great grasses.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_beni_zilal.default** — The Beni Zilal are the keepers of the secret. We watch from the shadows. Make foes of us at your peril.

**str_comment_special_clan_intro_embers_of_flame.default** — You may have heard of us. Men call us the Embers of the Flame. Generations ago, Heaven instructed us to prepare for a great cleansing of the land. Until that day, we smolder in silence. But when that day comes, our righteous wrath shall burn forth.

## NPC Comment-on-Action Strings
*Source: `SandBox/ModuleData/comment_on_action_strings.xml` — 148 entries*

**str_comment_captivity_release_companion.default** — It's good to be out of captivity.

**str_comment_captivity_release_companion_ransom.default** — Thank you for paying my ransom.

**str_comment_captivity_release_companion_ransom.ironic** — It was most generous and noble of you to secure my freedom.

**str_comment_captivity_release_companion_ransom.ironic_2** — How much did you need to pay to free me? It's not coming out of my share of the loot, what?

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_hunted_bandit_easy.default** — Well... Those bandits back there didn't give us too much trouble.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_hunted_bandit_easy.mercy** — Chasing down bandits like that... I suppose it has to be done.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_hunted_bandit_easy.cruel** — Those bandits never give us much trouble, but it is good practice I suppose.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_hunted_bandit_easy.outlaw** — Every time we run down another group of those bandits, I think, that could have been me, had fate worked out a bit different.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_hunted_bandit.default** — Well, that's one fewer group of bandits preying on travellers. But there will be more. There always are.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_hunted_bandit_merchant.default** — I hear you recently caught some bandits. Speaking as a merchant, we appreciate any efforts to make the roads safer.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_hunted_bandit_merchant.cruel** — I hear you recently caught some bandits around here. I say 'good work,' and I think other merchants around here will agree. Cleanse the roads of those vermin, so that trade can flow.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_hunted_bandit_merchant.merciful** — I hear you recently caught some bandits around here. Well, as a merchant, I appreciate that it will make the roads safer. Hopefully other desperate men will be deterred from going into a life of crime and villainy.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_castle.default** — I hear you took {SETTLEMENT_NAME}.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_this_city_devastated.default** — I was here when your people come over our walls. I do not know why they spared me. So many were not so lucky.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_this_city.default** — I watched your people come over our walls... I suppose I am grateful that they spared my life.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_this_city_showed_mercy.default** — I was here when your people came took our city... It was not as bad as we had feared. If you ordered them to spare us, well, I suppose I should thank you for that mercy.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_castle.chivalrous** — I hear you took the fortress of {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. A blow well struck!

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_castle.allied_default** — I hear you took {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Good work.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_castle.cruel** — I hear you took {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. I hope you made them bleed for what they did to us.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_castle.merciful** — I hear you took {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. I hope the cost in lives was not too high..

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_stormed_castle.dismissive** — I hear you took the fortress of {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. No doubt you found some traitor to let you through the gates.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_stormed_castle.default** — A hard day's work, taking {ENEMY_SETTLEMENT}. But worth it.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_stormed_castle.cruel** — I will never forget how we came over the battlements of {ENEMY_SETTLEMENT} and put its defenders to the sword.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_stormed_castle.mercy** — I will not forget the taking of {ENEMY_SETTLEMENT}... All sieges are terrible, even victories.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_stormed_castle.curt** — I'm not going to forget {ENEMY_SETTLEMENT}... A hard fight, but a glorious one.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_stormed_castle_easy.default** — Well... Taking {ENEMY_SETTLEMENT}... That wasn't as bad as I'd feared.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy.default** — I hear you defeated our enemy {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER} in battle.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy.friendly_chivalrous** — I heard that you fought and defeated {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. I wish you joy of your victory, my friend!

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy.curt** — I heard that you beat {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}... This is good.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy.chivalrous** — I heard that you fought and defeated {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. A blow well struck!

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy.liege** — So, you crossed swords with that rascal they call {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}, and emerged victorious. Good work.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy.unfriendly_spiteful** — I heard that you fought and defeated {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. Every dog has its day, I suppose.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy_great_battle.default** — I heard you defeated {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}, even though he had you outnumbered. Most impressive.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy_great_battle.default_2** — I heard you defeated {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}, even though he had you outnumbered. I salute you, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madame{?}sir{\?}!

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy_great_battle.default_3** — So {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER} came at you with a great big host and you whipped him anyway. Heh. Good work.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_our_enemy_great_battle.default_4** — There's a great deal of talk about you - how you beat {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER} even though you were outnumbered. Is that really what happened? Somehow I doubt it.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally.default** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP} in battle.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally.avenge** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP} in battle. I appreciate a worthy adversary.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally.avenge_2** — I don't know what treachery you used to defeat {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP}, but it will not work against me.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally.default_2** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP}. You're a wily foe, but I've run you to ground and now I shall finish you off.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally.avenge_3** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP} in battle. I'm here to even the score.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally.friend** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP} in battle. Well, I always knew you'd be a dangerous enemy.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally_disrespectful.default** — I hear you fought {DEFEATED_LEADER}, and won. {?GENDER}Her{?}His{\?} mistake cost us the lives of many brave men.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally_disrespectful.default_2** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP} in battle. I won't pretend that I grieved too much when I heard that.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally_disrespectful.default_3** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP} in battle. But don't think that I will fall so easily for your tricks.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally_disrespectful.default_4** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP}. Hah! It would have amused me to see {?GENDER}her{?}him{\?} cower before you.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_my_ally_disrespectful.calculatin** — I hear you defeated {DEFEATED_LEADER_RELATIONSHIP}. Well, I won't comment on {?GENDER}her{?}his{\?} standard of generalship, but that can't have been too difficult.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.default** — You won our last battle. That won't happen again.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.default_2** — When last we met, you had the better of me. But I assure you that it will not happen again!

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.chivalrous** — You won last time we fought. I look forward to a chance to even the score.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.chivalrous_high** — You emerged victorious from our last contest of arms. I congratulate you, and look forward to a chance to even the score.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.grudging** — You may have won last time we met, but that won't happen again.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.grudging_2** — You won last time we met. I hope you enjoyed your little victory. You won't have another one. Your tricks won't work twice.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.default_3** — When last we met, {PLAYER.LINK}, you had the better of me. If we ever meet in battle again, perhaps things will go differently.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.grudging_3** — Don't think I have forgotten our little battle. Now I know your tricks. If ever we are at war again, well, things will go differently.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_defeated_me.friendly** — I don't begrudge you your victory, the last time we met. I'm glad we no longer have to fight.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.friendly** — I will not forget our victory over {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.generous** — I remember our victory over {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. I will not forget your bravery in that battle.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.cruel** — Remember how we whipped {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}, and made of his men a feast for the crows? That's a sweet memory.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.now_enemies** — Whatever comes next, I will not forget how we once fought together against {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.cold** — We may have fought together against {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}, but even that cannot make up for everything else you've done.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.cold2** — I remember our victory over {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. I am grateful for the aid. But if you think you can call upon that favor, you are mistaken.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.goodnatured** — I hear you've been trying to take the credit for our victory over {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. I was on the battlefield too, you may remember.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.allied_upstanding** — I will always cherish the memory of our battle against {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. May all our battles be equally glorious.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.allied_sadistic** — My friend, I will never forget how we watered our last battlefield with the blood of {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}'s men. I hope you have the stomach for more.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_enemy.allied_sadistic_2** — I will not forget our victory over {DEFEATED_PARTY_LEADER}. Let us once again give thanks to heaven, and pray that we not grow too proud.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_i_defeated_you.neutral** — I remember our last battle. It was a good fight.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_i_defeated_you.enemy** — I remember our last battle. It was a good fight. Have you come for another?

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_i_defeated_you.spiteful** — I remember our last battle. You should know better than to cross paths with me again.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_you.neutral** — I remember when my allies and I last faced you. It was a good fight.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_you.gloating** — Do you remember when we left the fields red with your men's blood? I do.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_defeated_you.chivalrous** — I remember when we last met. Your side put up a good fight.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_my_ally_defeated_you.friendly** — I hear you came to blows with {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER}, and you were driven from the field.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_my_ally_defeated_you.spiteful** — I hear you came to blows with {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER}, and he gave you the thrashing you deserved.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_were_defeated.default** — It was hard going back there against {ENEMY_TERM}. I'm glad we all made it out alive.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_we_were_defeated.spiteful** — That battle against {ENEMY_TERM}. You failed, and we both paid the price.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you_pyrrhic.default** — I hear {ENEMY_TERM} beat you, but you put up a hard fight.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you_pyrrhic.default_2** — I hear you fought bravely against {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER} until you were finally overwhelmed by superior numbers.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you_pyrrhic.curt** — I heard {ENEMY_TERM} beat you, but it cost them a lot of men. Good.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you_pyrrhic.chivalrous** — I hear you fought bravely against {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER} and made the {ENEMY_TERM} pay heavily for their victory. I salute your courage and your men's sacrifice.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you_pyrrhic.ironic** — So apparently you're a tough bite to swallow. I hear {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER} paid heavily in blood to defeat you.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you_pyrrhic.spiteful** — I hear {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER} ran you down. Some speak of heroic last stands, but I say a defeat is a defeat.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you_pyrrhic.spiteful_2** — I hear {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER} ran you down and gave you the thrashing you deserve.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you.default** — I hear {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER} defeated you. Fear not, we will give them back double.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_our_enemy_defeated_you.spiteful** — I hear {VICTORIOUS_PARTY_LEADER} ran you down and gave you the thrashing you deserve.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_captured_our_castle.enemy_default** — You took {SETTLEMENT_NAME} from us. We will not forget this.

**str_comment_changeownerofsettlement_you_captured_castle.default** — I heard that you have besieged and taken {SETTLEMENT_NAME}.

**str_comment_changeownerofsettlement_you_captured_castle.chivalrous** — I hear you took the fortress of {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. A blow well struck!

**str_comment_changeownerofsettlement_you_captured_castle.enemy_goodnatured** — You have taken {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. So be it. I would have done the same, in your shoes. But I shall retake it.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.default** — I hear you'll be joining us in the service of {TT_LIEGE.NAME}.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.martial_unfriendly** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Pray do not disgrace us by behaving in a cowardly fashion.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.martial** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. I look forward to fighting alongside you against our foes.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.quarrelsome_unfriendly** — I hear you'll be joining us in the service of {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Well... Do yourself a favor, and stay out of my way.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.quarrelsome** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Fight hard against our foes, respect your betters, and don't cross me, and we'll get along fine.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.selfrighteous_unfriendly** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. If I were he, I would not trust you to clean the sculleries.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.selfrighteous** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Fight bravely and you will be well-rewarded. Betray us, and we shall make of you the kind of example that will not soon be forgotten.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.cunning_unfriendly** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. I do not pretend to be happy about his decision, but perhaps it is better to have you inside our tent pissing out, than the other way around.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.cunning** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. That is good. The more skilled fighters we have with us in these troubled times, the better. I shall be watching your progress.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.debauched_unfriendly** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. No doubt you will soon betray him, and I will have the pleasure of watching you die a traitor's death.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.debauched** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Excellent... I am sure that you and I will become very good friends. But remember -- if you betray us, it will be the biggest mistake you will ever make.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.goodnatured_unfriendly** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Well, I can't say that I would have trusted you, but perhaps you deserve the benefit of the doubt.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.goodnatured** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Good {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?}! Our {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} is a noble soul, and rewards loyalty and valor with kindness and generosity.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.upstanding_unfriendly** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Alas, from what I know of you I fear that you will disgrace us, but I will be happy if you prove me wrong.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us.upstanding** — I heard that you have pledged allegiance to {?TT_LIEGE.GENDER}the lady{?}lord{\?} {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Fight against our foes with valor, but also with honour and compassion. A good name is as valuable as a sharp sword or a swift horse in affairs of arms.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us_as_mercenary.default** — It's good to have you fighting alongside us.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us_as_mercenary.famous** — So, you've signed up to fight alongside us. I'm glad that you're on our side.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us_as_mercenary.unfriendly** — Let's see if you're worth what we're paying for you.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_joined_us_as_mercenary.hostile** — So, we've taken you on as a mercenary. I'm not sure I'd trust you.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_me.default** — Well... I can forgive many things, but it is hard to forgive treason.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_me.default_2** — You're a rebel and a traitor, {PLAYER.LINK}, but somehow I still can't bring myself to hate you.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_me.default_3** — You rebelled and broke your oath of fealty to me, {PLAYER.LINK}. Expect no mercy.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_me.default_4** — You rebelled and broke your oath of fealty to me, {PLAYER.LINK}, but now the Heavens have delivered you to me.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_us.default** — Your rebellion against {TT_LIEGE.NAME} was an act of treason.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_us.default_2** — You rebelled against {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Now, expect the punishment due traitors.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_us.default_3** — You rebelled against {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Look, I know you well. I'm sure you had your reasons. But you shouldn't have done that.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_rebelled_against_us.default_4** — Your rebellion against {TT_LIEGE.NAME} makes us enemies. But to be honest, I rather prefer things that way. Better to have the serpent outside your tent rather than in, wouldn't you say?

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_renounced_your_allegiance.default** — I heard that you renounced your allegiance to {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Well, that is your decision.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_renounced_your_allegiance.friendly** — I heard that you renounced your allegiance to {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Let us pray that we may not come to blows.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_renounced_your_allegiance.selfrighteous** — I heard that you renounced your allegiance to {TT_LIEGE.NAME}. Well, we're better off without you.

**str_comment_changeherofaction_you_renounced_your_allegiance.selfrighteous_2** — So perhaps now you're regretting renouncing your allegiance to {TT_LIEGE.NAME}?

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.default** — I hear you looted a caravan under my protection. I am not pleased.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.not_enemy** — I hear you looted a caravan under my protection. I'm going to assume that this was a misunderstanding.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.enemy_sadistic** — I see you have helped yourself to one of my caravans... I am not kind to thieves. Perhaps I shall take your hands and eyes as compensation.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.enemy_goodnatured** — You looted a caravan under my protection. Look, it's war, we all do things... But was there really a need for that?

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.enemy_upstanding** — Amongst war and death, trade alone keeps this great land together. If you insist on raiding my caravans and further undermining this world's prosperity, than I must defeat you.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.enemy_pitiless** — Spare my caravans next time and find the courage to attack me directly.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.enemy_default** — I can't stand idle while you disrupt my trade routes and raid my caravans, you must be brought to justice.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.enemy_pureevil** — You cost me a great sum of coin when you raided my caravan. I wonder if I could regain it through the sale of your organs.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.goodnatured** — My peasants tell me a man bearing your description looted their goods and coin. I suppose I should be grateful you didn't burn the buildings to ground.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.upstanding** — My peasants tell me a man bearing your description looted their goods and coin. I suppose I should be grateful you didn't burn the buildings to ground.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.pitiless** — My peasants tell me a man bearing your description looted their goods and coin. I suppose I should be grateful you didn't burn the buildings to ground.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.badtempered** — My peasants tell me a man bearing your description looted their goods and coin. I suppose I should be grateful you didn't burn the buildings to ground.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.upstanding_2** — I ask, for the sake of your honor, that you not raid anymore of my caravans.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.goodnatured_2** — You must think me a truely weathly man to raid my caravans and expect that I would not notice. I'll assume your actions were meant as a compliment, and that you'll find other means of income.

**str_comment_endplayerbattle_you_accosted_my_caravan.badtempered_2** — Rather than brand you a traitor, I will assume that you were too base and foolish to recognize that it was MY caravan you were attacking and not an enemies.

**str_comment_changeromanticstate_match_made_by_family.default** — Apparently my family believes that we might make a good match.

**str_comment_changeromanticstate_congratulations_marriage_self.default** — So! What a wedding... I look forward to a happy married life with you.

**str_comment_changeromanticstate_congratulations_marriage.default** — Congratulations to you and {FIRST_NAME} on your marriage.

**str_comment_changeromanticstate_congratulations_marriage.hostile** — So.. You married {FIRST_NAME}. No doubt you'll both be very happy.

**str_comment_changeromanticstate_stay_away_from_my_spouse.default** — You stay away from {FIRST_NAME}.

**str_comment_changeromanticstate_romantic_rival.default** — So... We're both courting the fair {FIRST_NAME}.

**str_description_insultcharacter_x_insulted_y.default** — {SIDE1TROOP} insulted {SIDE2TROOP}.

**str_description_insultcharacter_I_insulted_y.default** — I insulted {SIDE2TROOP}.

**str_description_insultcharacter_x_insulted_me.default** — {SIDE1TROOP} insulted me.

**str_description_insultcharacter_x_insulted_y_courtship.default** — {SIDE1TROOP} and {SIDE2TROOP} quarreled over their love for {SUBJECT}.

**str_comment_companion_on_honor_for_quest_success.default** — I am glad we were true to our word with {COMMENT_REFERENCE_HERO}.

**str_comment_companion_on_honor_for_quest_betrayal.default** — There's something I can't stay silent about... You broke your word to {COMMENT_REFERENCE_HERO}. This is hard for me to accept.

**str_comment_companion_on_generosity_for_party_morale.default** — I am glad that you look after your men well.

## World Lore / Lord-on-Lord Dialogue
*Source: `SandBox/ModuleData/world_lore_strings.xml` — 50 entries*

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_15_for_lord_1_14** — Fortune smiled on me. I was born to one of the richest houses in Calradia. My father spent much money to educate me, so that I can retain that wealth. And the first and most important thing I learned is that the common people are the source of my wealth, so I must protect the common people.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_15_for_lord_1_14_b** — Beyond that, I was taught what any aristocrat worthy of his noble name should know and how he should behave. Keep his word. Fight for his country. Have the grace to listen to the needs of the poor men who work his estate. Have the sense not to take their advice on how to manage it.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_15_for_lord_1_14_c** — My class was taught how to rule, and rule we should. But one of our number should always be above the others. Put us together in a Senate, as Lucon wants, and we will always quarrel and fight. Let an emperor or empress rule in the capital, and let their children succeed them, without any fuss. We shall give them a peaceful and prosperous countryside.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_14_for_lord_1_14** — We are the family of the martyred Emperor. Every man wishes to leave what he has to his children, be it a tiny patch of land or the imperial throne. Everyone in Calradia, rich or poor, grasps this. The universal principle of inheritance, not the obscure laws of the Senate, is what makes an Emperor in the eyes of the people.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_14_for_lord_1_14_b** — I will strive to be a good Empress. I'll do my best. But I know well that whoever wins this civil war, landlords will still cheat tenants, city guards will still demand bribes, warriors will still kill men to steal their cattle, drunken husbands will beat wives. The plague and the labor of childbirth will take more lives than all the evils of man put together.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_14_for_lord_1_14_c** — Still, men are willing to fight for me, though it gains them nothing, for no other reason that the throne is my right. I will not betray these men. If I win, in centuries to come, people will think back on my victory and think, 'Heavens smile on those who fight for their rights.' That is all one can do.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_17_for_lord_1_14** — All men are thieves at heart. I'd rather have one big thief than a thousand little ones. So, I believe in monarchy.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_37_for_lord_1_14** — I am the daughter of the Emperor Arenicos. If I were his son, all the Senate would be tripping over their beards and walking sticks to swear allegiance to me. One day I will stand before them as empress, and they will give me their oaths.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_1_for_lord_1_1** — We're of a very old family that has done great service to the Empire. But I'll tell you something - a man, whatever his bloodline, is only as good as his honor and his obediance to the law.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_1_for_lord_1_1_b** — The Senate chooses the Emperor. That is our law. It has been twisted, broken, or ignored for 100 years. But it has never been changed. Without law, without fealty to the written word, there is but tyranny and the mob.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_1_for_lord_1_1_c** — Senators understand the law. If a man does not understand the law, no matter how much money he has, he cannot enter the senate. I respect our soldiers but they cannot govern. If I win this war, I will reestablish the Senate's authority over the emperor.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_5_for_lord_1_1** — The Neretzes have always upheld the law, upheld order, and made sure that the best people are the ones in charge. So that's what I'm doing now.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_5_for_lord_1_1_b** — The quality of blood will always show itself. Look at Garios and his scoundrels. Play to the mob. Who are Rhagaea's people? Nobodies. She's a jumped-up adventuress.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_5_for_lord_1_1_c** — Anyway, Lucon. He's from a good family, you can't deny that. He knows our laws and respects our laws, and you know he'll keep up standards.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_20_for_lord_1_1** — Echerion the Tyrant-Slayer was my ancestor. Wouldn't be right if I fought for an upstart demagogue like Garios or a half-foreign adventuress like Rhagaea, now would it?

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_7_for_lord_1_7** — Our family has always sent its sons to become generals. It has been our privilege to lead the men of the Empire into battle. Without these men, there would be no empire. The great estates of the senators would be blackened ash.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_7_for_lord_1_7_b** — The soldiers of the Empire don't ask for much in return. They want an Emperor who will train them hard, fight them hard, and reward them generously. Let them choose the man to do that.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_7_for_lord_1_7_c** — The Heavens know I loved Arenicos. I shed my blood for him. But his dream of peace with our neighbors was moonshine. You can have war on the frontiers or war at home. I prefer war on the frontiers. Let the men earn glory, gold, and tales to tell their grandchildren.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_11_for_lord_1_7** — My people are the people of the hills. Up here, we watch out for each other. Your life and wealth depend on your neighbors spotting a Battanian raiding party coming your way. My people like Garios. They trust him. I'm not going to spill their blood fighting for anyone else.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_21_for_lord_1_7** — I am a rich man. I invest my money, and then I do whatever is necessary to make sure that money turns a profit. Does that answer your question?

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_46_for_lord_1_7** — The Empire, before it was an empire, was a Republic. Popular assemblies made the decisions. My family were known for their talents as rhetors. We took it upon ourselves to speak to the popular assemblies, to steer them to reason. It is not easy to get a tumultuous crowd to think in its interests and not follow its passions, but we tried.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_46_for_lord_1_7_b** — The popular assemblies are dead, of course. The temptation to turn our affairs over to a tyrant, or a gathering of rich old men - it was overwhelming. Who wished to deal with the chaos, the stubbornness, of a crowd? It was never easy. But I still believe that the only just way for a community to make decisions is for all its members to vote.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_1_46_for_lord_1_7_c** — Lucon and Rhagaea will never restore the assemblies. Neither has any faith in the people. Garios, well, he is no democrat, but he has that faith. I will fight for him. Maybe he will bring back the assemblies. No one else will.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_2_1_for_lord_2_1** — The boyars swore an oath to my grandfather to obey him as prince. They begged him to save them from the wrath of the Empire, which they had stirred up with their raids and their lawless ways.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_2_1_for_lord_2_1_b** — My grandfather did save the boyars, and ever since, their thankless heirs have tried to weasel out of that oath. They like to quarrel, and take what they want, and care nothing for the realm.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_2_1_for_lord_2_1_c** — I will break them. By the Heavens I will bring them to heel, or the knife will fall on them.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_2_3_for_lord_2_1** — Our family have been the masters of this corner of the woods since the gods willed that the trees grow and the rivers flow. Someone wants to call himself Prince of the Sturgians? We have no quarrel with that. Just let that prince know that on our land, we're still the masters.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_2_5_for_lord_2_1** — Two generations ago, the Sturgian lords entered into a covenant to give their allegiance to a prince. We surrendered our ancient freedoms so that we might be united in war. Was that wise? I have no idea. But I know that if we rupture that convenant now, forging it again would be long and bloody task. Perhaps an impossible one.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_5_1_for_lord_5_1** — My family? I was adopted by the fen Gruffendoc but really, I have no family. I was sent directly by the Heavens as a gift to the Battanians. They didn't know it, but they needed a strong king.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_5_1_for_lord_5_1_b** — Yes, they needed a strong king, like a herd of cattle on a mountain trail needs a herdsman who knows the trail. Herds in the mountains, you see... Sometimes the stubborn old bulls, set in their ways, wander off the trail and lead the others toward a precipice.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_5_1_for_lord_5_1_c** — The wise herdsman, you see, will slaughter the old bulls to prevent the destruction of the entire herd. And I am a wise herdsman.

**str_political_philosophy_lord 5_3_for_lord_5_1** — We are the sons of Derngil. Our forefathers came to this land in the ships from the west, in the time of the gods. We have been here a long time. And I tell you, never have we seen a leader like Caladog. A right murderous bloody bastard, a man with no father, some would say, and would I call them a liar? But he holds us together, somehow, and I would stomach a great deal of tyranny for that.

**str_political_philosophy_lord 5_5_for_lord_5_1** — We, the sons of Uvain, were passed over by the High King when it came time to marry their daughter. They chose Caladog. And, well, one might ask... What did that get them? But no matter, no matter. It's all done now. We have all sworn our oaths to Caladog. So let him rule.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_3_1_for_lord_3_1** — The Banu Hulyan have never sought glory or domination. Where some see an enemy, we see only a trading partner who has gone astray. For that reason, we have tried to treat all others with fairness and respect.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_3_1_for_lord_3_1_b** — For that reason, the clans have always brought their quarrels to us, to adjudicate. And it was natural that, when it came time for the Banu Asera to choose a sultan, that we were the ones chosen.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_3_1_for_lord_3_1_c** — But it is wearisome to be a Sultan. The clans cling to their grievances as though they were their children. It is not in men's nature to appreciate the fruits of peace and order. Rather, they brood over small injustices and perceived slights, and dream of shedding blood.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_3_3_for_lord_3_1** — We are the Banu Sarran. Our lineage is as old as is any of the Aserai. Our forefather Sarran was a grandson of Asera, no less than Qild or Hulyan. . But a hundred years ago we were driven into the desert. Only recently have we returned. The others look down on us for this.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_3_3_for_lord_3_1_b** — Unqid is a wise man. He knows how to keep the peace, to soothe over tensions. But there is only so much he can do. We can overlook an insult, or two. But if we overlook too many, perhaps some people will think that we would also overlook an injury. That would be dangerous.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_3_3_for_lord_3_1_c** — I would advise the other clans: Watch what you say about us. We have our pride, and our swords. Do not tempt us.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_3_5_for_lord_3_1** — The duty of a sultan is to lead the tribes in war, and to allow them to uphold their honor. It is not to make them love each other, and it is not to make men of honor sit down and pretend to be friends with thieves and scum in the name of 'peace.' That is all I will say.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_4_1_for_lord_4_1** — When my great-grandfather Osric Iron-Arm declared himself king of Vlandia, the emperor himself sent us a golden crown as a goodwill gift. Hmf. Do not trust gifts from the Empire.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_4_1_for_lord_4_1_b** — If you toss a bone into a pack of wild dogs, what does having that bone mean? It means that you get bitten a lot. I have spent most of my life in the saddle or sitting in front of a besieged fortress. Once I thought, 'I suffer, but at least my son will rule in peace.' Such lies we tell ourselves. There will never be peace.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_4_1_for_lord_4_1_c** — My son will rule, and he will fight his brothers and vassals. And after him my grandchildren will fight each other. At least, as kings and princes, they can enjoy a dry tent, good wine, and a soft bed between dusk and dawn. That is all the peace one gets in life.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_6_1_for_lord_6_1** — Urkhun, my forefather, gave the Khuzaits everything they had. They were as mangy steppe dogs, eating from the scrapheap outside the walls of the cities. He turned them into a pack of wolves. He raised his hand, and cities fell, and he gave the clans land to call their own.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_6_1_for_lord_6_1_b** — Is there a chieftain of the Khuzaits who does not like my decisions? Is there one who does not want me as khan? So be it - let him abandon his lands, the gift of my forefathers, and flee back into the great grass. I will not follow. I will not hunt him.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_6_1_for_lord_6_1_c** — But he who stays here, in the land won by my forefather, he lives under my hand. That is all there is to say.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_6_4_for_lord_6_1** — The Khergit have suffered greatly in the wars of the Khuzaits. So many of our men have fallen...

**str_political_philosophy_lord_6_4_for_lord_6_1_b** — It is for this reason that I lead the clan. The other clans, they think that because the Khergits are led by woman, that we are weak. They look at our land, our wealth, and think - we could take that. I can fight one of them, I can fight two, but I cannot fight them all.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_6_4_for_lord_6_1_c** — So long as Monchug has a firm hand on things, I do not worry much. The other clans dare not covet our lands and herds too openly. Yes... A strong khan can be a great blessing to the weak, so long as he remains strong.

**str_political_philosophy_lord_6_5_for_lord_6_1** — The Arkit are the eldest sons of the great she-wolf who gave birth to the Khuzaits. Properly speaking, Urkhun should have allowed us to lead the great war of conquest. But no matter, that time has passed. We respect the khanate and we respect the banner of the khan. We swore our oaths to Urkhun and we shall keep faith with our oaths, so long as his heirs keep faith as well.

**str_context_line.attacking_el** — {STR_SALUTATION}... Ready to give me a good fight?

**str_context_line.attacking_dislike_el** — Right, you. Prepare to get what's coming to you.

**str_context_line.old_friends_fighting_el** — {STR_SALUTATION}... If it comes down to a fight between you and me, well... I'll take no joy in it.

**str_context_line.first_meeting_sl** — Aye? Sorry, I don't think I know you.

**str_context_line.attacking_sl** — Halt. You want to tell me who you are, or shall we just have at it?

**str_context_line.in_tavern_sl** — What is it, stranger? Who're you?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_gang_leader_sl** — Yes? You need something from me? Who are you?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_under_command_sl** — {STR_SALUTATION}... Let me introduce myself.

**str_context_line.metbefore_sl** — {STR_SALUTATION}... It's been a while.

**str_context_line.under_command_sl** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I'm at your command.

**str_context_line.under_command_sl_2** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I'm at your service.

**str_context_line.metbefore_dislike_sl** — I don't know what we have to say to each other.

**str_context_line.metbefore_friendly_sl** — {STR_SALUTATION}... Good to see you.

**str_context_line.attacking_sl_2** — Do you have anything to say?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_ct** — Yours is not a face I know. What is your name, stranger?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_attracted_male_ct** — Em.... Greetings, my lady. I do not believe that we've met.

**str_context_line.first_meeting_drinking_dour_ct** — Eh. Wine here tastes like piss. Anyway, what do you want?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_gang_leader_ct** — You wanted to see me for something?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_under_command_ct** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I offer you my loyalty.

**str_context_line.attacking_ct** — Halt there. So, tell me who I fight?

**str_context_line.attacking_cruel_ct** — Halt there. Who are you? I would know whom I slay.

**str_context_line.metbefore_ct** — {STR_SALUTATION}... It's been a while.

**str_context_line.under_command_ct** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I'm yours to command.

**str_context_line.under_command_notable_ct** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I am at your service.

**str_context_line.metbefore_ct_2** — {STR_SALUTATION}... My heart is glad to see you.

**str_context_line.attacking_ct_2** — {STR_SALUTATION}... If you die well today, I'll be sure your courage is remembered.

**str_context_line.attacking_cruel_ct_2** — Say whatever you have to say. After that, you die.

**str_context_line.old_friends_fighting_ct** — Well. Here we are. Give me a decent funeral if I fall to your sword, and I'll do the same for you. Do you have anything to say?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_et** — Peace to you, stranger. What is your name?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_enemy_et** — What do you want, stranger? Who are you?

**str_context_line.attacking_unmet_et** — Halt there. So, tell me who I fight?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_under_command_et** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I offer you my loyalty.

**str_context_line.metbefore_et** — {STR_SALUTATION}... It's been a while.

**str_context_line.under_command_et** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I'm yours to command.

**str_context_line.under_command_notable_et** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I am at your service.

**str_context_line.metbefore_et_2** — {STR_SALUTATION}... Peace to you.

**str_context_line.friendly_et** — {STR_SALUTATION}... Peace to you... I am glad to see you.

**str_context_line.flirtatious_et** — I am very angry with you. Too much time has gone by since last you visited.

**str_context_line.dislike_et** — It looks like your sins have yet to catch up with you. But they will, believe me they will..

**str_context_line.attacking_cruel_et** — Ah, the Heavens are kind. What kind of death do you want, dog?

**str_context_line.old_friends_fighting_et** — Well, if it comes down to you and me, let's make it a fight that the bards will sing about, hey?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_it** — Well now, stranger. Peace to you. What is your name?

**str_context_line.first_meeting_it_2** — Stop there, stranger. I bid you peace. At least until I find out who you are, anyway.

**str_context_line.first_meeting_tavern_it** — Peace to you, stranger, though if you come any closer I may stick a knife in your belly, as one cannot be too careful these days.

**str_context_line.first_meeting_under_command_it** — {STR_SALUTATION}! I am honored to meet you. Let me introduce myself.

**str_context_line.metbefore_it** — {STR_SALUTATION}... My greetings to you.

**str_context_line.under_command_it** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I await your orders.

**str_context_line.under_command_notable_it** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I'm at your service.

**str_context_line.metbefore_enemy_it** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I'd wish you peace and prosperity, but of course I don't want that.

**str_context_line.attacking_it** — Such a pleasant surprise to see you. I hope my men can find some fetters of silver or gold, worthy of your rank, as it appears you may be gracing us with your presence tonight.

**str_context_line.attacking_1_it** — Well... Unless I reckon the odds falsely, I'd say you have a very good chance of feasting with your ancestors before this day is through.

**str_context_line.attacking_cruel_it** — Ah... Fate smiles on me today. I can think of no sweeter music than your death-rattle.

**str_context_line.old_friends_fighting_it** — Well. Here we are. I once thought friendship was sacred, but all sacred things are profaned in the end. Don't think I won't kill you if I need to.

**str_context_line.firstmeeting_st** — Aye? I don't think I know you. Peace to you, stranger.

**str_context_line.firstmeeting_enemy_st** — Stop there. Who are you? It is better we know each other's names, even if we fight.

**str_context_line.firstmeeting_attacking_cruel_st** — I don't know you... If you have anything to say, say it quickly. The ravens are hungry and I would not keep them waiting.

**str_context_line.first_meeting_under_command_st** — {STR_SALUTATION}. I am at your service.

**str_context_line.metbefore_st** — {STR_SALUTATION}... It's been a while.

**str_context_line.under_command_st** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I'm yours to command.

**str_context_line.under_command_notable_st** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I am at your service.

**str_context_line.hatred_st** — {STR_SALUTATION}...You'd best pray someone gives you a quick death in battle one of these days, because if you ever fall into my hands, you'll find I have a long memory, and do not forgive.

**str_context_line.attacking_st** — {STR_SALUTATION}... I think your luck has run out.

**str_context_line.attacking_hate_st** — I've waited a long time for this day. Have a good look around you, for soon your eyes will have little to see but the inside of a raven's belly.

**str_context_line.old_friends_fighting_st** — Well... Forgive me if I cannot wish you 'peace,' old friend. Fate does what it will.
